notes.title: Wall World 2 Announcement
notes.notes:
The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall! 

[previewyoutube=CBwohPsHDl4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]New frontiers, greater dangers.[/b] The Wall is more alive than ever, and this time, it fights back from both within and without. New monster types lurk not only on the surface but deep inside the mines, turning every dig into a battle for survival. Adapt to the ever-changing biomes, overcome hazardous anomalies, and master new ways to traverse the Wall - whether by foot, spider leg, or something even more powerful. 

[b]Upgrade, customize, and conquer.[/b] Your robospider is more than just a machine - it’s your lifeline. Swap out legs for tank treads, enhance its firepower, and fine-tune your exosuit to match your playstyle. From devastating new weaponry to game-changing movement upgrades, Wall World 2 offers deeper progression, letting you build the ultimate digging war machine. 

[b]A Living, breathing Wall. [/b]The mines stretch further than before, hiding lost technologies, mysterious artifacts, and uncharted wonders. Sphere City awaits as a hub for upgrades, interactions, and discoveries between expeditions. The deeper you dig, the more secrets you uncover - but be prepared, because some mysteries are better left undisturbed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/b21832806d2193dd722cf9fec24f69f313de55d0.gif[/img]
Wall World 2 builds upon everything that made the first game a thrilling rogue-lite adventure - expanding the world, more exciting combats, and adding more ways to explore, fight, and survive. The Wall is calling, wall diggers. Will you answer?

notes.title: Endless Mode
notes.notes:
The latest update for Karate Survivor is here, introducing the highly anticipated Endless Mode! This exciting new feature puts your skills to the test against infinite waves of increasingly challenging enemies, all set in a brand-new arena. Best of all, Endless Mode is available right from the start! Please make sure you have the latest version (1.2.0.277) of the game. 

[b]What’s in Endless Mode? [/b]

[list]
[*] Infinite Waves of Enemies: Face never-ending waves of foes that grow tougher with each round. Test your skills and see how long you can survive! 
[*] New Arena: Battle in a dynamic, ever-evolving environment. Each wave introduces new layouts and object placements to keep combat fresh and unpredictable. 
[*] Camera Movement: The camera is no longer tied to the character, allowing you to freely navigate the arena. 
[*] Leaderboards: Compete online and compare your performance with friends. Prove your worth and claim your spot as a top martial artist in Endless Mode! 
[*] Progression Integration: Bring the skills you’ve unlocked in the main game, like wall runs and obstacle rolls,into the arena. The more abilities you’ve mastered, the better your chances of survival. 
[*] Level Up: Enemies in Endless Mode won’t drop teeth or money, and you’ll receive card upgrades only after defeating each wave. This lets you focus entirely on refining your strategy as the challenge ramps up. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/9986356dd0c10fb04a6cd9578e1d66125c299e5f.png[/img]

Test your endurance, adapt to ever-changing challenges, and climb the leaderboards! Endless Mode is the ultimate test for true martial arts masters. 

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. As always, we’re excited to hear what you think of this update. Stay tuned for even more thrilling content!

notes.title: High Dynamic Mode & macOS Version!
notes.notes:
The latest update for Karate Survivor is here, bringing you a new gameplay mode! With the introduction of High Dynamic mode, experience the fast-paced street fights at an even more intense speed. Please make sure you have the latest version (1.1.0.237 Windows) or (1.1.0.32 macOS) of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/f03b71c2d47e2fd7a6f18fbe9cc7f4f0a6266049.jpg[/img]
High Dynamic mode is an optional feature that increases game speed and its elements by 1.5x for those who crave faster combat. Keep in mind, you’ll need to make strategic decisions faster than ever before. High Dynamic Mode is available from the start of the game and can be enabled or disabled before any run, on any difficulty. 

[b]Changes in High Dynamic Mode: [/b]

[list]
[*] Your character moves faster. 
[*] Attack speed is increased. 
[*] All animations play faster. 
[*] Time passes at an accelerated rate. 
[*] You receive upgrades more quickly. 
[*] Weapons break more quickly. 
[*] Enemies also move faster. 
[/list]
We're also excited to announce that Karate Survivor is now available on macOS!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy this new mode, and as always, keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
Karate Survivor is performing smoothly on the Steam Deck, so players can enjoy the game even before Valve's official verification process! 

While we’re still waiting for our turn in Steam’s review queue, we’re confident in the game’s compatibility and performance on this platform. From the start, we’ve been optimizing Karate Survivor to ensure a smooth experience when playing on the Steam Deck.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/e864ff3571c4050d491b6349356f0151551f77e8.png[/img]


[b]Display & UI[/b]

The game launches automatically at the Steam Deck’s native resolution, with all UI elements scaled for clarity and ease of navigation. Menus, HUD elements, and in-game icons remain crisp, ensuring a visually smooth and user-friendly experience. 

[b]Performance[/b]

Karate Survivor currently runs seamlessly on the Steam Deck, with no optimization issues. Installation and startup are hassle-free, with no additional pop-ups or launchers — simply tap and play. 

[b]Controls[/b]

Designed with gamepad compatibility in mind, Karate Survivor feels right at home on the Steam Deck. Controls are intuitive and responsive, providing an excellent gameplay experience tailored for handheld play. 
 
We’re eagerly awaiting official verification from Valve and will share more details in future updates.

notes.title: Update with difficulty modes
notes.notes:
We’re excited to bring you a new update for Katare Survivor, introducing difficulty settings designed for both players looking to relax and fun and those seeking a challenge. Please make sure you have the latest version (1.0.0.199) of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073307/fe51c33c5a81dbad3cf238b81c8dffe31b62cffb.jpg[/img]
[h3]The game now has 3 difficulty modes:[/h3]

[b]Fighter [/b]– for newcomers [i](available from the start)[/i]. This is the original, base difficulty mode where you can focus on having a good time. 

[b]Master[/b] – for genre veterans [i](available from the start)[/i]. In this mode, enemies will now deal damage on contact, much like other VS-like games. To avoid taking hits while attacking, you’ll need to position yourself much more precisely. Enemies with knives become particularly dangerous, making encounters with them especially risky. To stay on par with your enemies as you progress, you’ll need a strategic approach to upgrades throughout each run, though you likely won’t be able to defeat them all. This difficulty offers a serious challenge for dedicated players! 

[b]Legend[/b] – for legendary martial arts pros and fans of advanced movement [i](unlocks after completing all locations on ‘Master’ difficulty)[/i]. In this mode, enemies not only deal contact damage but also inflict damage through attack animations. Be careful – enemies will show no mercy! This mode demands complete focus, as well as the full use of all your moves and tricks. You’ll need to dodge attacks, strategically save healing items and weapons for later (just remember where you left them 😉), lure enemies into traps, and use mass neutralization zones to control large groups. You’ll also rely on somersaults to escape clusters of foes, slides through tight spaces, and deceptive rolls to throw enemies off your trail. These skills will become essential for survival and present a true challenge for legendary martial arts masters! 

We’re so grateful for the warm reception you’ve given Karate Survivor, your incredible support, and your positive feedback! We’re continuing to improve the game, so stay tuned and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Demo Update with Touch Damage Changes!
notes.notes:
We’ve heard your feedback and made an important adjustment to combat mechanics.

Instead of the previous system where the hero took damage every time enemies touched them, now, while your hero is performing a combo, they won’t take damage from enemies! However, once the combo ends and the cooldown begins, you’ll be vulnerable again.

This change was inspired by many of your comments about taking damage on contact during attacks, and we’re excited to see how it impacts your gameplay.

Let us know your thoughts in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3027930/discussions/0/4691154443773746732/]this thread[/url]: do you prefer this new system, or did you like the previous version better? Since this isn’t the final version of the feature, your feedback is crucial to help us refine it!

[*][b] Attack Animations for All Enemies.[/b] Every enemy will have its own unique attack animations, making combat feel more dynamic and immersive. 
[*][b] Expanded Attack Directions.[/b] We’re introducing new “upward” and “downward” attacks, giving you more control over where you strike. This adds greater depth to combat, allowing you to target enemies in different zones for a more dynamic fighting experience. 
[*][b]Improved Game Balance.[/b] We’ve adjusted the game’s balance to make the early stages more accessible for new players, while still offering a challenge for seasoned martial arts masters. 
[/list]
These are just a few of the changes we’re working on, and there’s plenty more to come. We can’t wait to reveal new levels and awesome abilities for you to master! 

The full release is coming very soon – be sure to wishlist and follow Karate Survivor to stay updated! Plus, you’ll get a chance to experience these updates with an upcoming demo in early October. Stay tuned for more updates, and once again, thank you so much for your support – you’re helping us make the game even better!
